exactOwnerActions: infra.production_domain: Owner buys/controls the domain and sets DNS at the registrar.
infra.production_hosting: Owner creates the hosting project, configures env, connects the repo/domain.
infra.production_env_vars: Owner sets each production secret in the host secret manager (never committed).
supabase.production_project: Owner creates the production Supabase project and supplies URL + keys.
supabase.production_migrations: Owner explicitly authorizes and runs migrations against the production project.
supabase.rls_tenant_isolation: Run the RLS runtime verification against the production project with two real test accounts.
supabase.backup_recovery: Owner enables PITR/backups on the production project and rehearses a restore.
stripe.account: Owner (or authorized company rep) creates the Stripe account, verifies identity + bank.
stripe.products_prices: Owner creates the live EUR + CHF recurring prices (active, distinct) in the Stripe dashboard.
stripe.webhook: Owner registers the live webhook endpoint URL in Stripe and copies the whsec_ secret to env.
email.sending_domain_dns: Owner adds DNS records at the registrar and verifies the domain in Resend.
observability.monitoring: Owner picks/configures a monitoring vendor + alert channels and rehearses rollback.
deploy.production_smoke: Operator runs smoke checks against the deployed environment.
owner.production_authorization: Owner completes the go-live approval packet AND makes a deliberate code change to lift PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED.
exactProviderActions: email.provider: Owner creates the Resend account and supplies the API key + verified from-address.
provider.signature_yousign: Owner sets up Yousign live (lift P8.7.4) OR approves the 'prepared, signed manually outside CloneStore' fallback.
exactLegalActions: legal.company_identity: Register/declare the legal entity; fill éditeur, directeur de publication, RCS/SIREN/SIRET, VAT intracommunautaire, siège social.
legal.country_launch: Per-country legal review (labour law, HR disclaimers) for FR/BE/LU/CH by qualified counsel.
legal.privacy_documents: Lawyer validates CGU/CGV/DPA/privacy/mentions; resolve placeholders; obtain sign-off.
legal.cookie_privacy_config: Define cookie policy + consent banner if required (CNIL/ePrivacy).
exactWarnings: Presence-by-shape of a key NEVER proves the external account/domain/webhook is configured or verified.
Payment mode can never be 'live' while the P10 hard floor (PRODUCTION_AUTHORIZED const) is false.
Live email/calendar/push/voice/telephony/SIRH providers remain blocked by design; local-safe fallbacks proven (P16C).
Legal placeholders present in /legal/mentions — legal sign-off outstanding.
NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL is localhost/unset — production domain not yet known.
nextSafeAction: Owner begins external configuration in this order: (1) legal entity + counsel sign-off, (2) production domain + DNS, (3) Supabase production project + authorized migrations + RLS runtime verify, (4) Stripe account + live EUR/CHF prices + webhook registration, (5) email provider + SPF/DKIM/DMARC, (6) monitoring vendor + rollback rehearsal, (7) complete the owner go-live approval packet. Then a DELIBERATE code change lifts the P10 hard floor. No production activation until every external proof exists.
verdict: E1 — EXTERNAL ENABLEMENT PREPARATION VERIFIED / OWNER, PROVIDER AND LEGAL ACTIONS REQUIRED
